title: Turn Raw Footage Into an Animated Short With One Prompt

viewer.problem: Manual video editing and motion effects take time
viewer.job: Understand how an AI-assisted editing workflow adds effects and offers a storyboard review

idea: Turn raw footage into an animated edit with Claude Code and ContentSkills.

claims.text: ContentSkills supports prompted video edits, effects and storyboard review before rendering.

scenes.say: Turn your raw footage into a ready-to-share video, with one prompt.
scenes.heading: ONE PROMPT

scenes.say: Yes, really. Drop in your clip, tell Claude what you want, and watch the edit come together.
scenes.heading: DROP DESCRIBE

scenes.say: A chart that builds as you speak?

scenes.say: Tell it. Then watch your footage transform.
scenes.heading: TRANSFORM

scenes.say: The toolkit is called ContentSkills. It gives you a storyboard to review before rendering, so you can change the scenes until they feel right.
scenes.heading: REVIEW YOUR STORY

scenes.say: Your footage. Your ideas. A video with a lot more motion.

youtube.title: Turn Raw Footage Into an Animated Short With One Prompt
youtube.description:
Claude Code and ContentSkills can turn raw footage into an animated short. Describe your edit, review the storyboard, and render with captions, graphics and effects.

Setup requires local tools; optional services can cost money.

Get ContentSkills: https://github.com/blotato/contentskills
